verdict.rationale: Numeral is a sales-tax SaaS with an API, MCP server and integrations, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or any opt-out control, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
